## Medical Services & Specialties
- [Chiropractic & Physical Therapy](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/chiropractic-and-physical-therapy): Spinal decompression, chiropractic adjustments, posture correction, shockwave and laser therapy.
- [Regenerative Medicine](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/regenerative-medicine): Stem cell therapy, exosome therapy, PRP, and non-surgical joint injections.
- [IV Therapy](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/iv-therapy): IV micronutrient therapy, NAD+ therapy, custom vitamin drips, and performance booster IVs.
- [Anti-Aging Medicine](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/anti-aging-medicine): Hormone replacement therapy (HRT), testosterone therapy for men, NAD+ IV therapy, and longevity biohacking protocols.
- [Aesthetic Treatments](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/aesthetic-treatments): Injectables, hair restoration, skin rejuvenation, and facial contouring.
- [Brain Health & ExoMind TMS](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/brain-health): Cognitive optimization, Neurofeedback, Clarity Direct Neurofeedback, PEMF therapy, vagus nerve stimulation, and non-invasive ExoMind TMS mental wellness therapy.
- [Personal Injury & Auto Accident Recovery](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/personal-injury): Whiplash treatment, post-MVA concussion care, injury rehabilitation, and medical documentation.
- [Weight Loss Programs](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/weight-loss-programs): Semaglutide GLP-1 medical weight loss, brown fat activation, metabolic testing, and exosome support.
- [Biohacking & Optimization](https://innovativemedicalwellness.com/en/biohacking-and-optimization): Red light therapy, cold exposure therapy, halotherapy salt therapy, and personalized performance plans.
